# Privacy policy

EZ Host does not collect, store or send any personal data to its maintainer. It has no accounts, no analytics and no crash reporting.

The app only contacts other services when you ask it to, and only for what that action needs:

- **Modrinth:** when you search for or install a modpack or plugin.
- **Mojang:** to download Minecraft versions and to look up a Minecraft username when you add a player to a whitelist.
- **mc-heads.net:** to show a player's head picture. This sends that player's name or ID to that service.
- **Mod loader and server downloads:** Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge, Forge and Paper download their server files from their own public servers.
- **Adoptium (Eclipse Temurin):** to download Java when a server needs it.
- **Steam (SteamCMD, the Steam Workshop and Steam's public web pages):** to download the Project Zomboid server and its mods with an anonymous login. EZ Host reads your Steam account names from your own PC only to find your Workshop collections, and doesn't send them anywhere except to Steam's own public Workshop pages.
- **playit.gg:** if you choose to connect it, to give each server an online address. playit.gg's own privacy policy applies to that service.

Your servers, settings and files stay on your PC, in `%APPDATA%\self-host-mc`. Uninstalling EZ Host keeps them.

Questions: open an issue at https://github.com/Ish-2601/Self-Host-MC/issues.
